Class FightSession

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.FightSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AgentSession
final class FightSession extends Object implements AgentSession
The trained network plays the user's own character against another player, in whatever world or server the user is in. Nothing is learned and nothing on the server is touched: it sees the opponent through the same colour-keyed picture as in training and presses the same keys.

There is no arena and no ground truth here, so what training got from the server is taken from what this client can see: a flinch tells who was hit, the last ground stood on is the floor.
